notes.title: Welcome to the new and fresh Hero Jumper
notes.content:
Get ready to jump into the most exciting update yet for Hero Jumper!

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]
With the brand new "Endless Mode", you'll be able to test your skills in an infinite adventure. In this mode, you'll face wave after wave of menacing robots that are out to get you. But don't worry - you're armed with a powerful gun to fight back! Use your shooting skills to take down every enemy in your path and set a new high score.

[h2]Level Editor[/h2]
And that's not all! I've also added a powerful level editor that lets you create your own unique jumping challenges. With this tool, you can design the perfect platforming adventure with your own custom obstacles and much more. Your imagination is the only limit when it comes to creating levels that challenge your friends or the entire Hero Jumper community.

[h2]New Style[/h2]
But what's a game without style? With this update, Hero Jumper is getting a brand-new look that will blow you away. From the sleek and futuristic robots to the stunning backdrops, every aspect of the game has been revamped to deliver an unparalleled visual experience. And to top it off, I've also added an immersive soundtrack and sound effects to make every jump and shot feel more impactful.

So what are you waiting for? Update Hero Jumper now and experience the most exciting and feature-rich version yet! Whether you're a seasoned player or a new adventurer, Hero Jumper is sure to provide you with endless hours of shooting, creating and fun. And as always have fun destroying Hero Jumperːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Models
notes.content:
[i]Hello Everyone,[/i]

With the new models added to Hero Jumper, let's talk about them.

[h2]Table[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/cc602478994590eccd70e73e473f1cc59a184e00.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/1458c314ddf6e1343a0e03e7e48c68571dede05f.png[/img][/url]

The new table looks cool to be placed on, but be careful not to break it.

With wood, the table is very strong and hard to break until someone hits it with a weapon.

[h2]Chair[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/131682d6157b19db0d8940ef806c386f0a57ef57.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/9ec42196b5a9b99544a9d0804b307bffd62e1783.png[/img][/url]

The chair is added mainly because it fits very well with the table.

This chair is not so strong, so please be careful with it.

[h2]Crate Box[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/7c334f67400844c310394eb4930f8064860e5237.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/71cb896f0c24544932365450434f3c0d7ddce906.png[/img][/url]

The new wooden crate box adds more mystery to Hero Jumper because no one knows what is in it.

I recommend breaking the crate with the destroyer, so it explodes as the model is made out of many little parts.

[h2]Trash Bin[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/e17e11f6c26c3afa14d24df18f0be7b28d0d8944.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/83caa1c19bc38ecb54c3586c0fc05150d1bcbf8c.png[/img][/url]

This trash bin is not interactable yet, but it makes the game prettier. With this bin, you can create your own stories and make more interesting creations.

I hope you like these new models.ːsteamthumbsupː

Have fun destroying Hero Jumper!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Saving System Incuded
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We decided it's finally time to add the most important feature, the [i][b]save and load system[/b][/i].
Using this system you can save your beautiful creations and load them after one or two days, why not after 1-2 months?

You can even play your saves from another pc that is miles away because this system is working with the Steam Cloud.

[h3]Workshop Fixed[/h3]

We recently found a large bug that prevents maps from being published in the Steam Workshop.

After many changes to the game's code, we finally managed to give the freedom for everyone to publish their maps to the public.

Have fun destroying Hero Jumper! ːsteamhappyː

[/list]

Have fun destroying Hero Jumper! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Forest Map Back With More Tools
notes.content:
[h3]Forest Map Is Back![/h3]

Remember the forest map from the old version of the game? When we [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2153600/view/3391799364880014653]changed to a new engine[/url] we removed the forest map. Now we added it back and made it better.

[i]Here you can see the difference between the old map and the new one:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/5b2188bcbeabb6b96b97f3694c729d364b42dbbb.png[/img]

[h3]More Tools More Fun![/h3]

In this update, we decided to make Hero Jumper more interesting by adding [b]destroyer[/b] and [b]vaporizer[/b].

That's from us for now. Have fun destroying Hero Jumperːsteamhappyː.

notes.title: Final Update Before Release!
notes.content:
[h2]3 Days Before Releasing![/h2]

Hero Jumper will soon release you on Steam publicly for you to play.

[h2]You Can Now Place Cube That You Can Drag[/h2]

Because Hero Jumper is soon releasing we decided to make one small change to the building menu of the game.

The new block you can place is a draggable cube that you can't destroy, but instead, drag it towards other objects and break them with the power of this cube. 


We hope you will like the game when it's released. Don't forget that there will be [u]10% discount[/u] on launch.

We decided improving the title screen(main menu) of the game by adding:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/1bcebbae1cb675f3af3bec3fc13ac0230e677744.png[/img]

And remember, there will be [b][u]10% discount[/u][/b] on the launch of the game!

notes.title: Big Changes
notes.content:
[h1]New Destruction System[/h1]

In this update we decided upgrading the core mechanic of the game - [b]destruction.[/b]

In this new destruction system we decided to make it possible for you to destroy objects part by part instead of explosion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42961295/065c27edafbc78848e3c269c759fc56a5c642306.jpg[/img]

[i]Example of the new destruction system[/i]

[h1]Materials[/h1]

Now, we added material types like metal, concrete and more.

[h1]More Effects[/h1]

We also decided adding some effects to the game
[list]
[*] When you hit object, particles of smoke appear as effect.
[*] Аccording to the selected object material, the corresponding effect is played.
[/list]

[h1]Our new item - Glass Cube[/h1]

As the material types were added we decided testing the glass material by making new block that is made of glass. You can place this block using the build menu.

And don't forget, on the release the game will be at [b]10% discount[/b]!!!
